{{Top|leg}}
The '''Fest police force''' was the main [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fest/Legends|Fest]], and the most visible arm of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-allied [[Fest collaborationist government|government]]. They were constant targets of the [[Fest Alliance Forces]], and suffered a rash of desertions.
